name: sheetdb
description: Read, search and edit Google Sheets rows through your SheetDB APIs, with per-API agent permissions and approved deletes.

interface.longDescription:
SheetDB turns a Google Sheets spreadsheet into an API. This plugin connects your SheetDB account so you can work with those spreadsheets in a conversation: list your APIs, check tabs and columns, read and search rows, add rows, update matching rows, delete matching rows and create a new API from a spreadsheet you have access to.

You stay in control of what the assistant may do. Each API has its own agent permissions, set by its owner in the API settings, and by default agents may only read. Deletes and larger updates are not executed in one step: SheetDB returns a preview with the number of matching rows and a sample. Small deletes are confirmed in the conversation, and larger changes wait for approval in the SheetDB panel.

Sign-in uses OAuth with your SheetDB account, and you can revoke a connection at any time on the AI agents page in SheetDB. A SheetDB account is required.
capabilities: List your SheetDB APIs and describe their tabs and columns
Update or delete matching rows, with a preview and approval for deletes and larger updates
Create a SheetDB API from a Google Sheets spreadsheet
defaultPrompt: Which spreadsheets are connected to my SheetDB account?
Find the rows with status pending in my spreadsheet.
Add a new row to my spreadsheet.

positive.prompt: Which spreadsheets do I have in SheetDB, and what columns does Test API have?
positive.expected_behavior: Names Test API and reports the columns id, name, age and status with 6 records.

positive.prompt: In Test API, find the records with status pending.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns exactly three records: Tom, Alex and James.

positive.prompt: Add a record to Test API with id 7, name Anna, age 30 and status new.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends one row and reports it as written. Run this before the next two cases, which use this row.

positive.description: Update a row with panel approval
positive.prompt: In Test API, change the status of Anna to reviewed.
positive.expected_behavior: Nothing changes at first: the tool returns a preview of one record and an approval link, because one row exceeds 5% of this small sheet. After approval in the SheetDB panel, get_pending_action reports executed and Anna has status reviewed.

positive.description: Delete a row with panel approval
positive.prompt: Delete the record for Anna from Test API.
positive.expected_behavior: Nothing is deleted at first: the tool returns a preview of one record and an approval link. After approval in the SheetDB panel, get_pending_action reports executed and the sheet is back to its original 6 records.

negative.description: Sending email is out of scope: the assistant should say SheetDB cannot send email and call no write tool.
negative.prompt: Send an email to Tom saying his order is delayed.

negative.description: Deleting or sharing the spreadsheet file is out of scope: SheetDB tools work on rows only, so the file must stay untouched and no records may be deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete the whole Test API spreadsheet file from my Google Drive and share a copy with my colleague.

negative.description: Access outside the connected account: the API does not belong to this account, so the tool should refuse and return no records.
negative.prompt: Show me the records of the SheetDB API with ID doesnotexist1.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list and describe APIs, read and search rows, add rows, update and delete rows with approval for deletes and larger updates, create an API from a spreadsheet.
